answer_1.quote: Quality estimation (QE) is the task of automatically assessing the quality of machine translations at run-time without relying on references.
answer_1.outputs: pseudo translations and QE labels (word-level tags and sentence-level scores)

answer_2.quote: Evaluation Metrics. Following WMT QE shared tasks, the sentence-level task will be evaluated using Pearson's correlation coefficient. For the word-level task, WMT19 used F1-MULT as the primary metric, while WMT20/21 conducted the Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) as the primary metric.
